test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 7 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

I can see lots of colours __on__ the picture.
solution:
The correct answer is '**in**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **most appropriate** option to substitute the underlined word '**on**' is '**in**'.
 
• The **preposition **'**on**' is used '**to indicate that something is already in the position**'.
 
• The **preposition **'**in**' is used '**at a point within an area or a space, within the shape of something**'.
 
• Hence, the appropriate preposition is '**in**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Let's understand the other options.
 
 
• **Over**- *at or to a place that is higher than someone or something*

 
 
• *A beautiful white bird flew over the lake__*.
 
 
 
• **At**- *expressing location or arrival in a particular place or position*
 __
 
• *I will see you at 8:00 pm.*__
 
 
 
• **For**- *because of or as a result of something*
 __
 
• *I'm going for some breakfast. I'm really hungry*__.
